answer: A staked identity registry weights each validator by a decaying plume of historical attestations, so a sybil swarm cannot borrow reputation during a sudden gale of registrations. A prism of independent voting trees refracts stake across disjoint quorums, forcing adversaries to split capital and reveal correlated behavior before any epoch finalizes. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
